findings.title: Retry-count delete branch is not restricted to SMS reminders
findings.body: The second `OR` branch of `deleteMany` is `{ retryCount: { gt: 1 } }` with no `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS` filter. This SMS cron will delete any `WorkflowReminder` whose `retryCount` exceeds 1, including EMAIL and WHATSAPP reminders. Today only this handler increments the column, but the column is generic on the model. As soon as another scheduler uses `retryCount`, this job will silently wipe that scheduler's reminders. Move the method filter outside the `OR`, or add it to the retry branch.

findings.title: Unguarded DB update inside catch can abort the whole cron run
findings.body: The `catch` block now awaits `prisma.workflowReminder.update` before logging. If this update fails (DB error, or the reminder was deleted concurrently, e.g. booking cancelled), the error escapes the `for` loop. The request returns a 500 and all remaining reminders in the batch are skipped. The original error is also never logged because the `console.log` comes after the update. Wrap the update in its own try/catch, or log first and swallow the update error.

findings.title: Reminders with no message or recipient are never counted as retries
findings.body: When `message` is empty or `sendTo` is null (e.g. missing `smsReminderNumber`), neither branch of the new retry logic runs. These permanently unschedulable reminders are re-fetched and reprocessed on every cron run until their scheduled date passes, which is the behaviour this PR is meant to stop. Increment `retryCount`, or delete the reminder, in this case too.

findings.title: OR on unindexed retryCount likely forces a full table scan each cron run
findings.body: Adding `OR retryCount > 1` with no method filter means Postgres cannot use only the existing `(method, scheduled, scheduledDate)` index. With no index on `retryCount`, this `deleteMany` will probably scan the entire `WorkflowReminder` table on every cron invocation. The cost grows with the table, which holds email and WhatsApp reminders as well as SMS ones.
